'''B5-R8''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The droid was present on [[CZ-198]] as a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|supply vendor]] providing captured gear for Republic forces and the [[Department of Adjudication|Adjudicators]] engaged in the [[Seizure of CZ-198]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
B5-R8 was first added as a Reputation Vendor to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. The droid was later removed in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
